title: Caesar Cipher
description: Decrypt this message that has been encoded with a Caesar cipher. The encrypted message is: synt{pynffvpny_pelcgb}
hints: This is a simple substitution cipher where each letter is shifted by a fixed number
The message should be readable English when decrypted correctly
ROT13 is a common Caesar cipher variant
solution: Apply Caesar cipher decryption with shift value 13 to get flag{classical_crypto}
writeup: Caesar cipher is one of the simplest encryption techniques. Each letter is shifted by a fixed number of positions in the alphabet. ROT13 is a special case where the shift is 13, making encryption and decryption the same operation.
